source.place: Final sentence: transport by the finite dualizing comparison, with identity and successive-coefficient normalization

title: Qh representative intrinsic restriction composition
statement: For every cochain complex representative P at level n, the intrinsic finite-dualizing restriction composition equation holds after applying the derived localization functor Q.

proof.text: On a representative complex, the section-normalized comparison maps are characterized on scalar-unit sections. Quotient representatives compose, and the exact localization compositor transports the resulting square.

lean.statement: theorem finiteDualizingIntrinsicRestriction_comp_Qh {r m n : ℕ} (hrm : m ≤ r) (hmn : n ≤ m) (P : CochainComplex (Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) (ModuleCat (finiteDualizingCoeff l E n))) ℤ) : (finiteDualizingIntrinsicRestriction l E X (hmn.trans hrm)).inv.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≫ (normalizedDVRResComp l E X hrm hmn).inv.app ((sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence X (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1))).functor.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)) = (sfIntrinsicDerivedEquivalence X (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (r + 1))).functor.map ((Sheaf.derivedRestrictScalarsCompIso (ProEt.topology X) (finiteDualizingQuotient_comp l E hrm hmn)).inv.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)) ≫ (finiteDualizingIntrinsicRestriction l E X hrm).inv.app ((Sheaf.derivedRestrictScalars (ProEt.topology X) (finiteDualizingQuotient l E hmn)).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)) ≫ (normalizedDVRRes l E X hrm).map ((finiteDualizingIntrinsicRestriction l E X hmn).inv.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P))
